messages.text:
Hi Sarah,

Thanks for the update. I'd like to go with the $286.41 store credit, please.

Thanks,

Eric

Hi Eric,

Store credit it is. I've set the $286.41 against your account for the NerdOctaxe, and it gets applied the moment the unit reaches our warehouse in Chattanooga. It sits as a balance on your account and comes off automatically at checkout on your next order, on any miner we have in stock. Nothing goes back to a card, and there's no fee or deadline on it.

The return still reads as on its way to us, so once you've dropped the box off with the label there's nothing else for you to do. Write Shop···· on the outside, send just the NerdOctaxe, and keep the PSU and the rest. Tracking on the return is (number hidden) if you want to follow it.

I'll let you know as soon as it lands and the credit is live.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

Hi,

I forgot to write the RMA number on the outside of the box. Will that be a
problem?

Hi Eric,

No problem at all. The return is logged against the label's tracking number, (number hidden), so the warehouse matches it to your RMA when it scans in. The number on the box just speeds up the sorting, it is not what identifies it.

Nothing more for you to do. The return still reads as in transit to Chattanooga, and the $286.41 credit goes onto your account as soon as the unit checks in there. I'll write to you when that happens.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
